discovery.summary: Replatform is the right strategy: fix critical SQL injection, hard-coded secrets, unauthenticated endpoints, SQLite on local disk, single AZ and backup gaps, then containerize. Readiness is 35/100 due to these blockers.

requirements.summary: Replatform legacy-inventory to Amazon EKS as inventory-service: 2 min/6 max Graviton replicas in us-west-2, Amazon RDS PostgreSQL multi-AZ, USD 450/month budget, 99.9% SLO. Open: traffic growth sizing, dev/test budget, data migration window.

modernization.summary: Successfully modernized the legacy inventory application into a containerized microservice. Ported all 6 JSON API routes (/api/items, /api/items/{id}, /api/orders) with full parity, maintaining all legacy status codes and response formats. Fixed SQL injection in the search endpoint by using bound parameters with LOWER() LIKE LOWER(:pattern). Implemented atomic conditional stock decrements with rowcount checking to prevent overselling across replicas. Added input validation using json_body/int_field/float_field helpers. Report generation moved to a Kubernetes CronJob that writes to S3 or stdout instead of local filesystem. Both service tests (25 passed) and manifest validation (55 policy checks) passed successfully.

terraform.summary: Built a prod-ready inventory-service on Amazon EKS in us-west-2 with Graviton nodes, RDS PostgreSQL, ECR and a private S3 bucket for nightly reports. Terraform is valid and all spec requirements are addressed.

k8s_validation.summary: Applied four fixes to the inventory-service manifests: added CPU/memory limits, set readOnlyRootFilesystem to true, pinned the container image tag, and added pdb.yaml to base resources. All kubeconform and policy checks now pass; the deployment rolled out successfully on kind with all smoke tests passing.

finops.summary: Legacy EC2: USD 71.89/month. Target as designed: USD 622.88/month (8.7x today). Optimized: USD 207.57/month. Optimized target costs USD 135.68 more than today (2.9x), which is the price of HA, not a saving. Optimized fits the USD 450/month budget with USD 242.43 headroom.
